name: alice-editor-extensions
description: Build and package the Alice editor extensions

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:zed
scripts.test: cargo test --locked -p alice-editor-core && npm --prefix vscode test
scripts.package:vsix: npm run build:native && node scripts/package.cjs vsix
scripts.package:zed: npm run build:zed && node scripts/package.cjs zed
scripts.package: npm run package:vsix && npm run package:zed
